query:
SELECT
            i.key_hash,
            i.email,
            i.expiry,
            COALESCE(
                JSONB_AGG(
                    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                        'slug', r.application,
                        'admin', r.admin
                    )
                ),
                '[]'::jsonb
            ) AS "roles!: sqlx::types::Json<Vec<Membership>>"
        FROM invites i
        LEFT JOIN invite_roles r ON r.invite = i.key_hash
        GROUP BY i.key_hash;
